_doc: FACS expression data. au_map: FACS Action Unit -> ARKit base blendshapes (never the TalkingHead composites mouthSmile/mouthOpen/eyesClosed, to avoid double-driving), following the ARKit<->FACS convention and calibrated per-model (e.g. AU25 parts the lips mostly from the bottom, mouthLowerDown 0.5 + mouthUpperUp 0.1, as real lips part, instead of jawOpen). expressions: name -> AU recipe. Recipe AU weights are the FINAL levels (one fixed intensity per expression): final morph = recipeWeight * au_map weight, clamped 0..1. Unilateral AU via _L/_R suffix (e.g. AU12_L). kind 'mood' (default) holds until replaced; kind 'beat' plays once with its envelope {in, hold, out} ms. Moods never use jawOpen (AU26), which fights the lip-sync visemes; AU25 stands in where a canonical combination has AU26. The 7 core recipes use the canonical EMFACS-7 AU combinations; the rest are documented blends of the same primitives. au_limits (per avatar, from visual review): AU -> {max, beatMax?, note}, the highest level that still reads natural on this avatar in a held mood (beatMax for beats, default max). avoid: [{aus: {AU: level, ...}, note}], combinations that read wrong together: no recipe may exceed every listed level at once. Levels count a unilateral AU on its side (AU12 + AU12_L). test/facs.test.js enforces both; nothing is clamped at runtime.

_sources.emfacs: Emotional FACS (Ekman & Friesen 1983) — canonical AU combinations for the basic emotions. https://www.paulekman.com/facial-action-coding-system/
_sources.au_to_arkit: ARKit<->FACS mapping convention (each ARKit blendshape ~ one FACS AU). https://melindaozel.com/arkit-to-facs-cheat-sheet/ ; clinical blendshape<->AU mapping https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2451958826001995 ; interactive ARKit-52<->AU guide https://arkit.miniface.org/faces
_sources.stylized_3d: AU-Blendshape: Fine-grained Stylized 3D Facial Expression Manipulation (arXiv:2507.12001) — approach for driving stylized (cartoon) 3D faces via Action Units, and the need for per-model AU calibration.

AU1.note: inner brow: 0.6 is the classic sad and pleading brow (owner); higher reads tented; real p99 0.52

AU2.note: outer brow: above 0.5 held looks startled; real p99 0.49

AU4.note: on this rig browDown also drops the lids (76% at 0.6, 60% at 1.0) and brows meet the glasses frame

AU5.note: sclera above the iris from 0.5 (eye 132% at 0.6): staring

AU6.note: real smiles: cheekSquint about 1/3 of the smile; weak alone on this rig

AU7.note: lid tightening reads suspicious/sleepy; real p99 0.38

AU9.note: barely visible on this rig; real p99 0.25

AU12.note: from 0.6 the corners crease into the cheeks (wide 'Joker' smile)

AU15.note: the classic sad frown goes to 0.6 (owner); cartoon pout above; real p99 0.30 (iPhone under-reports)

AU17.note: chin raise; with mouthShrugUpper gone from au_map it no longer bulges the upper lip

AU18.note: a pucker held while talking turns visemes into a tube

AU19.note: tongue only in a beat, after the jaw opens (offset)

AU20.note: real p99 0.18; widens the 'aa' teeth band

AU24.note: lip press; mouthClose left out of au_map so it no longer seals the lips during speech

AU25.note: lips part mostly from the bottom (au_map lower 0.5, upper 0.1); above this the teeth show

AU26.note: no held jaw opening; beats only

AU28.note: lips vanish; upper lip edge tears with 'O' at 1.0

AU43.note: eye 68% at 0.4: anything above 0.2 reads sleepy; only sleepy should go there

AU63.note: sclera below the iris from 0.6: eye-roll

AU64.note: lids follow the gaze down; reads eyes-closed from 0.8

avoid.note: lid tightening on a broad smile reads forced or smug (real: eyeSquint about 0.1x the smile; Turrisi: AU7 not in happiness)
wide smile + parted lips shows a band of teeth: the rictus
knit brows press on the glasses and lower the lids (eye 64%)
a smile under lowered lids reads smug/sleepy

happy.description: Warm, genuine smile: glad, pleased, friendly, good news.
happy.facs: EMFACS-7 happiness: AU6+AU12, lips part (AU25) for an open smile; no AU7 (not part of happiness, reads tense)

sad.description: Sadness: sorrow, grief, bad news, missing someone.

surprise.facs: EMFACS-7 surprise: AU1+AU2+AU5+AU26, with AU25 in place of AU26, played as a beat (held, it stares)

fear.description: Fear: scared, alarmed, anxious about a threat.
fear.facs: EMFACS-7 fear: AU1+AU2+AU4+AU5+AU20+AU26, with AU25 in place of AU26; AU7 left out (lids read suspicious on this rig)

disgust.facs: EMFACS-7 disgust: AU9+AU10+AU16, with AU4 brow lowering and no AU15 (real disgust shows no frown)

contempt.description: Contempt or smugness: one-sided smirk, superiority, sarcasm.

laugh.description: A brief laugh: something genuinely funny, a joke landing.
laugh.facs: extension: intensified happiness (AU6+AU12) + lips part (AU25) + jaw drop (AU26) carrying the laugh; no AU7

excited.description: Excitement: thrilled, can't wait, high-energy enthusiasm.
excited.facs: extension: open happiness (AU6+AU12+AU25) + surprise brows and eyes (AU1+AU2+AU5)

amused.description: Amused: playful, teasing, light-hearted, mildly funny.
amused.facs: extension: lopsided happiness (AU6, AU12 stronger on the left) + left dimpler (AU14_L) + lips part (AU25); no AU7

wistful.facs: extension: sadness brows (AU1+AU4) x faint happiness (AU6+AU12)

tender.description: Tender warmth: caring, comforting, compassionate, gentle support.
tender.facs: extension: raised inner brows (AU1) + a slight brow lowerer (AU4), concern without a smile

love.facs: extension: happiness (AU6+AU12) + inner-brow warmth (AU1) + lips softly parted (AU25); no AU7

proud.description: Pride: accomplishment, confidence, praising someone's achievement.

relieved.facs: extension: gentle happiness (AU6+AU12) + inner-brow lift (AU1) + lips part (AU25)

shy.description: Shy: bashful, embarrassed, flattered by a compliment.
shy.facs: extension: a small lopsided smile (AU12 stronger on the left, AU6) with a hint of inner-brow raise (AU1); no dimple

curious.description: Curiosity: interested, intrigued, wanting to know more.
curious.facs: extension: brow raise (AU1+AU2, left higher) + AU5 + lips part (AU25)

skeptical.facs: extension: asymmetric brow (AU2_L raise + AU4_R lower) + AU7 + one-sided dimpler (AU14_R)

confused.facs: extension: knit brows (AU1+AU4) + one raised outer brow (AU2_R) + AU15 + lips part (AU25)

pensive.description: Thoughtful: considering, reflecting, weighing an answer.
pensive.facs: extension: mild brow lower + lid tighten (AU1+AU4+AU7) + pressed, raised chin (AU17+AU23) + AU14_R

nervous.facs: extension: worried brows (AU1+AU4) + lip stretch/press (AU20+AU23) + AU7 + faint smile (AU12)

disappointed.description: Disappointment: let down, mild regret, 'that's a shame'.

sleepy.description: Sleepy or tired: drowsy, exhausted, bedtime.

pleading.facs: extension: strong inner brow raise (AU1+AU2) + AU5 + slight frown (AU15) + lips part (AU25)

wink.description: A playful wink: a shared secret, a joke, flirting.
wink.facs: AU46 wink (unilateral AU43) + same-side cheek raise and smile (AU6_L+AU12_L)

tongue_out.description: Tongue out: cheeky teasing, silly playfulness.
tongue_out.facs: AU19 tongue show + lips part (AU25) + jaw drop (AU26), the tongue offset so it comes out after the jaw opens

raise_eyebrows.description: A quick eyebrow flash: emphasis, greeting, 'oh!', interest.

close_eyes.description: Eyes closed for a moment: savoring, relief, a fond memory.

eyeroll.description: An eye roll: exasperation, mock annoyance, 'whatever'.

yawn.facs: AU1+AU25+AU26+AU43 (brows up, jaw wide open, eyes shut)

side_glance.description: A sideways glance: suspicion, conspiratorial teasing.

look_up.description: Eyes up, searching memory: recalling a name or a date, "let me think".

look_down.description: A brief look down: sheepish, humble, owning up to something.
